Positive 24-hour performance and persistent ETH/BTC support make this a low-conviction shadow candidate rather than a directional conclusion.

ETH shows the weakest latest mark-price comparison, negative 12-hour return, sharply negative order-book depth imbalance, negative taker imbalance, falling CFGI, and elevated recent liquidation acceleration. The positive 24-hour return and resilient medium-horizon ETH/BTC relationship are counterevidence.

The evidence supports near-term two-sided uncertainty: deterioration and deleveraging argue against uninterrupted continuation, while persistent ETH/BTC support, positive 24-hour returns, and non-extreme sentiment argue against assuming a confirmed breakdown. A bounded range better preserves this disagreement than a strong directional forecast.
